description: 阿拉伯杀：将军驱王，Rg8#将死
explanation_en: A checking rook move drives the king from the corner, then the rook and knight coordinate for a mating pattern with Arabian and hook-mate features.

intro.popup: 💡 阿拉伯杀：用将军把王从角落驱赶到另一格，再完成将杀。解说提示：此局也具有钩杀特征，了解两者区别即可。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Arabian mate: Use check to drive the king away from the corner, then deliver mate. This position also has hook-mate features; note the distinction between the patterns.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：本局兼具钩杀与阿拉伯杀特征，知道差别即可，关键是掌握这类车马封锁的棋形。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: This position combines features of hook mate and Arabian mate. The key is to recognize how the rook and knight restrict the king; the two patterns can overlap.

moves.popup: 白车Rb8+将军！驱逐黑王，为下一步做准备。
moves.popup_en: Rb8+! The rook checks and drives the black king away, preparing the next move.
The black king is forced to Kg7, leaving the corner.

moves.popup: 白车Rg8#，将杀！车控g线，马封逃格，黑王无处可逃。
moves.popup_en: Rg8# delivers checkmate! The rook controls the g-file, and the knight covers the escape squares, leaving the black king trapped.
